item.title: Free gender-based violence support program available in Chatham-Kent
item.description: The John Howard Society of Windsor-Essex County is has launched a free new gender-based violence support initiative available to Chatham-Kent residents. The supportive approach to finding empowerment (SAFE), is a confidential program for people 16 and older who have experienced, been impacted by or are at risk of gender-based violence, said the agency in a […]

item.title: C-K job fair draws large crowd to Bradley Centre
item.description: With dozens of employers on hand, and hundreds of positions available, the Chatham-Kent Workforce Week job fair drew a large crowd to the John D. Bradley Centre on Wednesday. item.title: Chatham Maroons have shot at historic season
item.description: The Chatham Maroons are on pace for their best regular season in Greater Ontario Hockey League history.

item.title: Nutrition program fuels young bodies and minds
item.description: Students who are properly nourished have better odds in the classroom for reaching their true potential, say organizers of VON’s Ontario Student Nutrition Program. item.description: Pain Court’s Gavin Schinkelshoek won two gold medals at the OFSAA swimming championship this week in Windsor.

item.title: Pain Court's Pat Myers refereeing hockey at Paralympics
